stem: What is the correct way to rewrite sentence 7?

options.label: A
options.text: Two hours later the car stopped, and my head shot up. I must have dozed off.

options.label: B
options.text: Two hours later, the car stopped, my head shot up; but then I must have dozed off.

options.label: C
options.text: The car stopped two hours later. My head shot up; yet I must have dozed off.

options.label: D
options.text: The car stopped, my head shot up, it was two hours later and I must have dozed off.
